title: A new synthetic approach to the 3,4-dihydro-1H-[1,4]oxazino[4,3-a]indole system from ethyl 1H-indole-2-carboxylates and activated glycerol carbonate
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,18947-18970
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02996A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Inesa Zagorskytė, Eglė Arbačiauskienė, Greta Račkauskienė, Sergey Belyakov, Aurimas Bieliauskas, Patrick Rollin, Algirdas Šačkus
An efficient synthesis of a small library of potentially bioactive 3,4-dihydro-1H-[1,4]oxazino[4,3-a]indoles is described through the reaction of ethyl 1H-indole-2-carboxylates and activated glycerol carbonate.
